slides.title: the 6 fixes
slides.sub: wrong → right. do all 6 next session.
items: behind the neck → upper chest
elbows back → elbows down
half reps → arms straight up top
thighs floating → under the pad
swinging → a small lean is fine
more weight → more reps first

slides.title: 1 · bar path
items: never behind the neck
chest up to meet the bar
bar stays in front of your face

slides.title: 2 · elbows
items: think elbows into your back pockets
hands are just hooks
feel it under the armpits

slides.title: 3 · the top
items: let the bar pull you up
feel the stretch in the lats
then pull again

slides.title: 4 · the seat
items: set the pad before the first set
no lifting off the seat
now the weight can't pull you up

slides.title: 5 · the lean
slides.sub: a small lean back is fine.
items: the lats do the same work
a bit more upper back joins in
just don't rock to move the weight

slides.title: 6 · progress
items: hit 8 reps? add weight
4–7 reps? same weight, +1 rep
under 4? drop the weight
